latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor Job Posting — initial release

- Instantly converts job postings (TXT, DOCX, PDF, MP4 up to 200MB) into 60-second recruiting videos with visuals and voiceover.
- Fast, cloud-based video generation with no installation required; outputs ready-to-share MP4s in 1–2 minutes.
- Simple onboarding: automatically handles authentication and session creation, including anonymous 7-day free access.
- User prompts like "export", "upload", "credits", and more trigger intuitive, mapped actions (status, upload, render, etc).
- Smooth HR workflow: upload or paste job text, describe your video, and export directly—tailored for recruiters, no editing experience needed.
- Comprehensive error handling and smart status updates for a seamless experience.
